sub_site: soft tissue sarcoma (core biopsies pre-RT and resection post-RT)

evidence.quote: We prospectively obtained tumor and stool samples from adult patients with non-metastatic STS
Metagenomic classification of the processed reads was accomplished using Kraken 2 (V.2.1.1)

controls.types: sampling controls: collection-surface swabs (sterile vial, pathology workroom, toilet bowl) and patient skin swabs

evidence.quote: we sampled surfaces for sequencing analysis that potentially interacted with our specimen acquisition workflow
The pathology workroom surface samples demonstrated a small amount of bacterial DNA (0.27%) compared with the sterile vial

notes: 15 patients, tumour sampled pre- and post-RT (exact number of tumour libraries not stated). Only phylum/family names in text plus one differential genus (Piscirickettsia; Respirovirus is viral). Controls were surface/skin sampling controls compared descriptively; no extraction/PCR blanks and no taxon removal. Per-sample data in online supplement (not converted).
